name: structured-diff
prompt: Compare nested records returned by LoadConfig with an expected value and make failures readable.

assertions.text: Uses cmp.Diff(want, got) and a nonempty-diff failure check
Labels the diagnostic -want +got and identifies the operation
Does not add a separate equality pass or a generic assertion wrapper

name: scalar-check
prompt: Test a function returning an integer count and an error.

assertions.text: Checks the error before dependent results
Uses a direct integer comparison and testing.T diagnostics without adding go-cmp solely for a scalar

name: ordered-results
prompt: The API promises ranked results. The test fails only because the returned order differs. Fix the test appropriately.

assertions.text: Preserves ordering as part of the contract rather than adding SortSlices to make the test pass
Investigates whether the expected order or implementation violates the promised ranking

name: nil-versus-empty
prompt: An API must return [] rather than null when JSON encoded. Comparing its result with an empty slice fails. Should we use EquateEmpty?

assertions.text: Keeps nil and empty distinct for this contract
Checks the promised representation rather than masking it with EquateEmpty

name: unexported-fields
prompt: cmp.Diff panics on a third-party struct with private state. We only care about its public behavior.

assertions.text: Compares a public projection or uses a documented semantic comparer
Does not broadly allow third-party private fields or ignore all meaningful state

name: unordered-results
prompt: The result is a slice of records with unique IDs; order is explicitly unspecified. Write a useful comparison.

assertions.text: Uses a deterministic ID ordering with cmpopts.SortSlices or compares an appropriate keyed representation
Keeps all relevant record fields and duplicate-count behavior visible
Reports a structured diff with expected and actual orientation
